fields.description: Issue features local political and civic commentary opposing revival of a Miami general sales tax and discussing municipal finances and utility rates. Reports on gambling enforcement actions affecting Greater Miami booking places and related impacts on employment and fines, with additional coverage of Miami Beach gambling and policing. Includes ongoing "Miami's Most Attractive Working Girl" contest coverage highlighting a Florida Power & Light Company employee, plus racing news and tips (Hialeah Park and Tropical Park dates), telephone rate decision updates, and assorted columns and local social/rumeur items.
